seoTitle: How to Block a Buyer on eBay (Site & App)
metaDescription: Block a buyer on eBay from the website or mobile app to stop them from purchasing your items or sending messages.
intro: If a buyer has caused issues in the past, eBay lets you block them from purchasing your items or messaging you again, and the process works a little differently depending on whether you're on the website or the app. This guide covers accessing your Blocked Bidder/Buyer List and adding usernames from either platform.

steps.heading: Open your Blocked Bidder/Buyer List
steps.body: Find this list in your seller settings on either the eBay website or the mobile app.

steps.heading: Add the problematic buyer's username
steps.body: Enter the username of the buyer you want to restrict from interacting with your listings.

steps.heading: Confirm the block is active
steps.body: Verify the buyer has been added to your list so they're prevented from purchasing or messaging you going forward.

steps.heading: Review your selling preferences regularly
steps.body: Periodically check your blocked list and selling preferences to keep your account protected as new issues arise.

faq.question: Can I block a buyer from the eBay app?
faq.answer: Yes, the guide covers blocking buyers from both the website and the mobile app.

faq.question: What does blocking a buyer prevent them from doing?
faq.answer: It stops them from purchasing your items or sending you messages if they've caused problems before.

faq.question: How do I identify red-flag buyers?
faq.answer: The guide includes tips for spotting buyers worth blocking based on past behavior and interactions.

faq.question: Is this useful for small sellers or only high-volume stores?
faq.answer: It's useful for both small sellers and high-volume stores who want to stay safe and in control on eBay.
